<h2>Code by language</h2>
<p><strong>src/Duck.java</strong></p>
<pre data-code-block-mode="2" data-code-block-lang="java">public class Duck {
{{SPACE}}
    void quack() {
        System.out.println("Quack");
    }
}
</pre>
<p><strong>duck.py</strong></p>
<pre data-code-block-mode="2" data-code-block-lang="python">def quack():
{{SPACE}}
    print("Quack &#10003;")
</pre>
<p><strong>duck.js:</strong></p>
<pre data-code-block-mode="2" data-code-block-lang="javascript">export const quack = () =&gt; "Quack";
{{SPACE}}
{{SPACE}}
export default quack;</pre>
<pre data-code-block-mode="2" data-code-block-lang="typescript">export const quack = (): string =&gt; "Quack";</pre>
